description: Source code for the MIDI extractor component in Android, including classes for MIDI data extraction, media track handling, and engine initialization.

classes.name: MidiSource
classes.description: Media track helper class for MIDI data, manages buffer reading and format retrieval.

classes.name: MidiEngine
classes.description: Handles MIDI engine initialization, buffer management, seeking, and data rendering.

classes.name: MidiExtractor
classes.description: Main class for extracting MIDI tracks and metadata from data source.

methods.name: MidiSource::start
methods.description: Starts MIDI data streaming, allocates buffers.

methods.name: MidiSource::stop
methods.description: Stops MIDI data streaming, releases buffers.

methods.name: MidiSource::read
methods.description: Reads MIDI data buffer, handles seeking if requested.

methods.name: MidiEngine::initCheck
methods.description: Checks if MIDI engine was successfully initialized.

methods.name: MidiEngine::allocateBuffers
methods.description: Allocates buffers for MIDI data rendering.

methods.name: MidiEngine::seekTo
methods.description: Seeks to specified position in MIDI data.

methods.name: MidiEngine::readBuffer
methods.description: Reads and renders MIDI data into buffer.

methods.name: MidiExtractor::countTracks
methods.description: Returns number of available MIDI tracks.

methods.name: MidiExtractor::getTrack
methods.description: Returns a new MidiSource for the specified track index.

methods.name: MidiExtractor::getTrackMetaData
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for a specific track.
